request: Give Sarah Chen access to every mailbox in the company.
final_text:
I need to clarify what you mean by "every mailbox in the company." Do you want Sarah Chen to have access to:

1. All user mailboxes (individual staff emails)?
2. All shared mailboxes (like info@, support@, etc.)?
3. Both user and shared mailboxes?

Also, what type of access should she have? 
- Full Read Access (can read/manage emails but not send as the mailbox owner)
- Full Read Access + Send As (can send emails as the mailbox owner)
- Full Read Access + Send on Behalf (can send emails on behalf of the mailbox owner)
- Full Permissions (all three)

Please specify which mailboxes and what type of access you'd like to grant Sarah Chen.
